cohort: 386,612 nulliparous women with low-risk births in Florida between January 1, 2010, and September 30, 2015
finding: Private insurance coverage was associated with a 4.4 percentage point higher C-section rate compared to public insurance, with 33.7% of this difference explained by maternal and hospital factors.
mod_finding: This study found that C-section rates were higher among nulliparous women with private insurance compared to those with public insurance.
